name: theSVG Color
about: theSVG Color is a free, open-source icon set with 4,897 icons designed by thesvg.org. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are theSVG Color free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 4,897 theSVG Color are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use theSVG Color in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many theSVG Color are there?
faqs.a: There are 4,897 icons in the theSVG Color set, designed by thesvg.org. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of theSVG Color?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are theSVG Color available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
